verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data downloads and registry extracts are a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that MCA publishes datasets or extracts. The only items are two probes recording HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, so no content beyond robots.txt was ever fetched. Confidence is low because the verdict reflects a blocked probe rather than confirmed absence.
